description:
Add a website to a project: analyze it and scrape a free sample of its products.
Each customer has free analyses each month. After them, an analysis charges the
prepaid balance when the job is created, without an approval. scout_get_balance
shows the free analyses left and the price of one. If none are left, confirm the
price with the user before you call this tool.
Returns the setup job; poll it with scout_get_job(job_kind="setup") until it is
COMPLETED, then check the sample with scout_get_sample.
A job that FAILED with the error_code CURRENCY_NOT_AVAILABLE found that the website
does not offer the currency: no switch of the website shows its prices in it. The error
of the job names the currency the website shows, when the analysis found it. The
analysis is used, also a paid one. Ask the user for a currency the website offers, then
analyze the website again.
A project without localization gets the country and currency of this website.

country: ISO 3166 code of the market to scrape, e.g. "CZ".
currency: ISO 4217 code of the prices to scrape, e.g. "CZK".
name: scout_analyze_website
title: Add and analyze a website
